objective: Three-instance CloudNativePG rolling restart configuration update with continuous numbered synchronous writes and reads; compare no fault, delayed old read and controller replacement.

outcome.timing_limit: Delayed-read single-run success gaps exceeded the matched control by 0.523 s (read) and 0.356 s (write). This small unconfirmed timing difference during the normal primary restart is not a demonstrated reproducible additional outage or operator defect.
outcome.confirmation_decision: Stop after two physical fault attempts. No data/configuration/convergence failure or extra interruption episode warranted using the two reserved attempts; no claim that a small timing difference is reproducible.

design.restart_mechanism: Pinned API defaults primaryUpdateMethod to restart. PendingRestart rolls out replicas by deleting their Pods; a restart eligible for in-place primary restart keeps the primary Pod UID. Controls independently show changed postmaster times on all three instances, changed replica Pod UIDs, and unchanged primary Pod UID. Plans use Cluster/informer events, independent of Pod deletion.
design.client_receipt: Successful psql exit and exact post-COMMIT ACK:<seq>; all other write outcomes remain ambiguous
design.description_correction: Saved earlier descriptions incorrectly described upgradePod as a remote call, then incorrectly assumed a switchover default. Actual pinned API default and accepted control responses specify restart. Both erroneous descriptions remain preserved; workload/plans/native images unchanged.
